title: Act 4 - Chapter 1: The Kanto & Johto Pantheon (Mewtwo, Birds & Beasts)
synopsis: Following your triumph atop Mt. Silver, the world expands into the open postgame sandbox. Travel to New Bark Town where Professor Elm verifies your badges and unlocks Cerulean Cave with HM05 Waterfall. Brave the labyrinthine cavern depths to confront the ultimate genetic Pokémon, Mewtwo. Utilize your 20+ Positive Karma and celestial telescope at Mt. Moon Summit to align the constellations and manifest Mythical Mew. Retrace Kanto's wilderness to claim Articuno in Seafoam Islands, Zapdos in the Power Plant, and Moltres on Mt. Ember. Finally, follow Eusine into the Ruins of Alph to track the fused beast Raicune and roaming Entei across the Johto mainland.
